rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is clearly or unmistakably so.

example.traditional: 好明顯佢係特登咁做嘅。
example.jyutping: hou2 ming4 hin2 keoi5 hai6 dak6 dang1 gam3 zou6 ge3

rows.jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dak1 ceot1
rows.note: Use this when the meaning is that something is immediately obvious from seeing or observing it.

example.english: You can tell unmistakably at a glance that they are a beginner.
example.traditional: 一眼就睇得出佢係新手。
example.jyutping: jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hai6 san1 sau2

rows.note: Choose this when “unmistakably” means unquestionably or beyond doubt rather than visually obvious.

example.english: The reform is unmistakably beneficial in the long run.
example.traditional: 呢項改革長遠嚟講無疑係有益嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 goi2 gaak3 coeng4 jyun5 lai4 gong2 mou4 ji4 hai6 jau5 jik1 ge3
